race.comment: LINE 'EM UP LOUI (2) grows a leg for rider Wiggins who has three wins and two placings from just six steers and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Saves his best form for this distance range and should be right there when the whips are cracking. NOVELA (7) placed over this course and distance last time out and rider Cormack stays on top. Sure to give backers a great sight. NOLAN (4) is a last-start winner who gets some weight relief and draws the inside marble. Plenty to like about his prospects. MISS MONEYPENNY (9) will be high on confidence following that last-start victory here and should be discounted lightly. THE EXTREME CAT (1) rounds out the selections.
